nodes.statement: However, a remarkable breakthrough of the CS theory shows that under certain conditions on the mixture matrix and the number of measurements (see below), the sparse solution can be recovered uniquely by solving a convex relaxation of the problem, which is obtained by replacing the ell 0 norm with the ''closest'' convex ell p norm, namely the ell 1 norm, leading to the following minimization problem : v^*=undersetvargmin\|v\|_ell 1 = undersetvargminsum_i=1^N |v_i| s.t. Av=a, Cv=c, Gv=g, Tv=t which is a convex optimization problem whose solution can be obtained in polynomial time.
